claims.label: PROVED_AT_STATED_SCOPE
claims.statement: For every finite real A,B there is an odd n such that, for the one-fresh-bit activation F_n of balanced n-bit majority g_n, G(F_n)-(1/2)G(g_n) > A I_ctl + B[U(F_n)-(1/2)U(g_n)].
claims.quantifiers: For all A,B in R with finite values, there exists an odd positive integer n and the displayed genuine Boolean pair (g_n,F_n).
limitations: Refutes the local selector-plus-new-U transfer template, not global GU'.
Does not refute FEI and does not give unbounded H/I.

claims.label: PROVED_AT_STATED_SCOPE
claims.statement: For the same family, the singular data-coordinate part of the exact activation ledger equals (1/2)n a_n^2 log_2(1/a_n^2), where a_n=binom(n-1,(n-1)/2)/2^(n-1), while the summed smooth remainder is O(n a_n^2)=O(1).
claims.role: Identifies the aggregate upper-set asymmetry mismatch that prevents deletion of the child structural charge.

claims.label: NUMERICAL_CORROBORATION
claims.statement: Direct Walsh/restriction computation agrees with the scalar identity for n=1,3,5,7 to at least 60 decimal places; exact-binomial scalar evaluation passed 1008 assertions through n=1001.
claims.scope: Finite corroboration only; the all-n conclusion is analytic.

claims.label: OPEN
claims.statement: No complete proof or genuine Boolean counterfamily with unbounded H/I is established by this run.
